name: Juliano Laham
place: São José do Rio Preto, São Paulo, Brazil

credits.title: 8 Segundos: O Desafio
credits.overview: Helena is the daughter of rancher Sinval and the sister of João Donato, a renowned international rodeo champion. Her dream is to become a top female rodeo rider, despite her father’s objections, so she divides her time between secret riding practice and her work as a doctor in Barretos.

credits.title: De volta à Bahia
credits.overview: A video of a young surfer's rescue goes viral on the internet, revealing the unexpected encounter between Maya (Bárbara França) and Pedro (Lucca Picon), two promising surfing talents. Introduced by PH (Felipe Roque), a surfing idol, they are surprised to discover they are already connected by the rescue that went viral

credits.title: Quarta-feira de Cinzas
credits.overview: Three siblings travel to support their eldest brother in his battle with depression, but end up trapped in a mysterious town rife with drugs, murder, and dark secrets. Forced to confront their own demons, they discover that survival can cost more than they imagined.
